methods.ph: Sum the original Table 6 daily-maximum counts and observed-day denominators across April–September, the common full monthly support. Fractions describe those observed days; they are not percentages of 30-minute readings.
methods.spot_comparison: Original Table 2 spot ranges remain attached with their April–October period and 0.3 m depth. Continuous records are approximately 0.5 m at 30-minute intervals. The ranges and common-day counts are different observation designs.
methods.chlorophyll: Use the owner's unchanged75-row selected cohort. Same calendar dates preserve separate clocks, source timezone labels, activity IDs and original rows.
methods.flow: Retain the existing upstream USGS02186702 daily-mean and prior-seven-calendar-day context without recomputation or assigning discharge to the lake sites.
methods.interpretation: These descriptive observations inform receiving-water response context and monitoring design. Source-pressure attribution requires the spatial/temporal model and source inventory; annual export scenarios retain their own mass units and support.
